visible_condition: stock photo, actual item condition cannot be determined
hidden_risks: actual physical condition and presence of scratches or rust
whether the required mounting strap is included
structural integrity and weight capacity of the physical unit
response.best_proof: a real photograph of the actual item showing its current condition and all included accessories
response.drop_reason: the seller used a stock/catalogue photo instead of photographing the actual item
response.failure_mode: valuing a used item as brand new based on a pristine stock photograph while missing real-world wear or missing parts
